_comment: Routine action kind `verb` (mchatai_macOS/docs/ROUTINES_ARCHITECTURE.md §3.3, §4.6). v1.1. Only verbs marked unattended:true in portal/capabilities.json (no such field exists yet) may run, dispatched through PortalAppletRegistry.dispatch so the grant is enforced. The Swift floor refuses dangerous ids (mail.send, audiocast publish/unpublish, hub publish, share, deploy) and any routines.* write or turn-driving verb, whatever content says.
summary: Run one app action on a schedule.
help: Runs a single mChatAI+ action that is marked safe to run unattended. Actions that send, publish or share are never run by a routine; a routine can only propose them.
